english.title: Transported animals in Wales without EU documentation

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Welfare of Animals Transport Wales Order 2007

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without lawful authority or excuse failed to comply with Article 4(1) of Council Regulation (EC) No 1/2005 relating to transport documentation in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to article 5(1)(b) of the Welfare of Animals (Transport) (Wales) Order 2007and sections 73 and 75 of the Animal Health Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
without lawful authority or excuse
transported animals without carrying documentation in the means of transport
stating origin and ownership, place of departure, the date and time of departure, intended place of destination and the expected duration of the intended journey

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and/or a level 5 fineTime limit for prosecutions:
6 monthsNote
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
